translation: Mukomana apo ataenda, Dhavhidhi akamuka kumabvazuva echamhemu, akawira pachiso pake pasi, akazvimbopfidza kanhatu — kaviri — kanhatu: ok, akagwadya katatu, uye vakasanazana mumwe nomumwewa ⟨את⟩ shamwari yake, vakachema mumwe nomumwewa ⟨את⟩ shamwari yake, kusvika Dhavhidhi akaoma kusuruvara.
